“INTRe DATE
Sept 18 2024

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping
District symbols as shown on Map No. 16-1

in the area bounded by:

A line 225 feet south of and parallel to West Marquette Road; South Western Avenue;
A line 400 feet south of and parallel to West Marquette Road; the public alley next west
of and parallel with South Western Avenue

To those of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 6738 S. Western Avenue
